metadata.description: A project-agnostic, AI-assisted dev flow for Claude Code, packaged as one installable plugin.

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Project-agnostic AI-assisted dev flow: route feature vs bug, gather grounded context, gate on a plan (always human-approved), author and audit acceptance tests before the build, build minimally, review and fix the diff, then independently verify what ships, always-human review, and open a PR. Bundles the orchestrator (dev-flow) plus verify-ticket, plan-brief, investigate-bug, author-acceptance-tests, audit-tests, verify-build, commit, pr, pr-fix, and debrief — plus the standalone discuss.
